capabilities: Create Anki flashcards from Obsidian through pop-up interfaces
Create new Anki decks from inside Obsidian
Sync the Anki collection with one button
Choose deck and model/template when creating cards
extras: README covers features and installation but not card syntax or usage examples; the AnkiConnect add-on must be running in Anki for sync to work.
motivation: The author built it to reduce the friction between note-taking in Obsidian and flashcard-making in Anki, providing an Obsidian-like experience instead of manual transfer.
problem: Moving between Obsidian for note-taking and Anki for flashcards involves friction: copy/pasting text and switching windows to create cards related to the note being written.

relations.evidence: structuring them with metadata and syncing effortlessly via AnkiConnect
Keep your flashcards up to date with one button to sync Anki instantly !

summary: Flashcard plugin that creates Anki decks and cards from Obsidian notes and syncs the collection via AnkiConnect.
